anomalies.description: The commit changes docs/plans/20260804-1900-wp4c1-adjudicationfailuredeclared-plan.md, whose name prefix reads as 2026-08-04 19:00 (no zone). The commit is recorded at 2026-08-04T00:30:25Z (+02:00 local: 02:30:25). The same path is also recorded in c1479132 (00:16:04Z), df3464c (parent, 00:21:44Z), 777bbbb (15:01:41Z) and c89c043 (15:29:41Z). Every recording precedes 19:00 on that date in UTC or +02:00. Under M-TIME, file names are not timestamp sources and recording != decision != entry into force; no decision or clock fact is inferred.

Every hit of the UNCLASSIFIABLE commit except .claude/CONTEXT-ARCHIVE-2026-07-08.md is in this research programme's own artefacts (docs/knowledgeos/chronological_knowelgeos_ablation_theory/analysis/**, docs/knowledgeos/reviews/2026-09-29-...). The pattern is broader: 21 of the 51 matching commits (20 DOC-OR-GOVERNANCE + a72528b), dated 2026-09-30 or 2026-10-01, are programme artefacts. They include cf2f6b9, which commits PROTOCOL-A.md and capture_a.sh themselves, and 0122e0e, which commits the LOOP-1BC task files. The historical DOC-OR-GOVERNANCE count would be 27, not 47. The ET set and the earliest trace are unaffected.

self_contamination_rule_recommendation: Yes, add an explicit rule fixed in advance (not applied here). R-SELF: before classification, any changed path under a declared programme-artefact root (initially docs/knowledgeos/, listed in a versioned SELF-ROOTS.txt) gets path class P-SELF. P-SELF hits are kept in the raw hit files but ignored by C2-C5, and P-SELF paths are excluded from the C3 all-P-DOC test. A commit whose only hits are in P-SELF paths is classed SELF-ARTEFACT, counted separately in 30_summary.tsv, and never contributes to other classes or to the earliest-trace fields. The rule is path-based, not date-based (dates are unvalidated under M-TIME) and not branch-based. Hypothetical effect: the 20 DOC self-artefact commits become SELF-ARTEFACT; a72528b stays UNCLASSIFIABLE because of its .claude/CONTEXT-ARCHIVE hit; the ET set is unchanged. Also disclose when the captured state contains the protocol's own commit.
